AD.name: Andorra
AD.lines: white centre + white outer, Spanish-style markings
AD.script: Latin (Catalan); i for "and", many words end in consonants
AD.tell: orange dot on left of plate, yellow guardrail reflectors, CG/CS kilometre markers

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.lines: yellow outer, centre white or yellow
AE.tell: Gen3 white car with black roof racks, black-white striped signposts and curbs

AL.name: Albania
AL.lines: all white, often faded; rare double outer lines with a wide gap
AL.script: Latin (Albanian), Ë ë very common, occasional Ç ç
AL.tell: red strip on left of plate, unique in Europe; black-top bollards; roof water cylinders

AQ.name: Antarctica
AQ.tell: trekkers on ice, penguins, no vehicles or roads

AR.name: Argentina
AR.lines: dashed white or double yellow centre + white outer, mixes of the two common
AR.tell: black plate with black dot, white chevrons with red arrows, RN/RP km markers

AS.name: American Samoa
AS.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention; small concrete roads often unmarked
AS.tell: counted as US, green tropical mountains, one-storey box houses, plain metal sheet roofs

AT.name: Austria
AT.tell: white bollard, black nipple top, dark red reflector; blue km markers with comma decimal; EINBAHN

AU.name: Australia
AU.lines: almost all white centre + white outer, yellow only in alpine areas
AU.tell: white bollard, red front reflector stopping mid-side, black-text GIVE WAY, gum trees

BD.name: Bangladesh
BD.lines: white centre + white outer where marked, many roads unmarked
BD.script: Bengali, headline across top of words, many triangular letters
BD.tell: turquoise plates unique, red-and-white concrete bollards, smoky Gen 4, shitcam

BE.name: Belgium
BE.lines: all white, continuous or broken; short dashed outer lines on bike paths
BE.script: Latin (Dutch in north, French in south, German in east)
BE.tell: red licence plate text, yellow guardrail reflectors, orange signposts, holed concrete poles

BG.name: Bulgaria
BG.lines: all white, noticeably thin, thinner than Romania's
BG.script: Cyrillic (Bulgarian) plus Latin on signs; Ъ present; улица/ул for street
BG.tell: poletop with 3 big alternating hook insulators, dead March Gen 3, mortar-patched roof tiles

BM.name: Bermuda
BM.lines: single solid yellow centre, no outer lines; white zig-zags occasionally
BM.tell: black car with front visible, long all-white plates, pastel stone houses with white roofs

BO.name: Bolivia
BO.lines: centre yellow, white, or a mix of both; outer always white
BO.script: Latin, Spanish; Aymara/Quechua names, Wiphala flag
BO.tell: white Gen 3 car no antenna, very curvy wooden poles, red brick buildings, MAS graffiti

BR.name: Brazil
BR.lines: double yellow centre + white outer; single dashed yellow occasionally
BR.tell: ladder poles, black-painted sign backs, yellow-on-black chevrons, red soil, .br

BT.name: Bhutan
BT.lines: white where present, mountain roads often unmarked, double white outers near Thimphu
BT.script: Dzongkha in Tibetan script, unique on Street View, English alongside
BT.tell: all-red licence plates, grey Google car with no antenna, yellow-topped white road markers

BW.name: Botswana
BW.lines: white centre + yellow outer, triple white centre on main roads
BW.script: Latin, English signage, Tswana place names, Afrikaans virtually absent
BW.tell: black-yellow striped signposts, yellow rear plates, A-roads, random small blurs

BY.name: Belarus
BY.lines: no road markings, the only coverage is a Minsk walking trekker on pedestrian streets
BY.script: Cyrillic (Belarusian/Russian); ў and і absent from Russian; вул for street
BY.tell: single Minsk trekker, sea-green street signs, Holy Spirit Cathedral twin towers

CA.name: Canada
CA.lines: yellow centre, usually single + white outer
CA.script: Latin, English with British spelling; French in Quebec
CA.tell: MAXIMUM speed signs, diamond T-intersection signs, km/h, Gen 2 and Gen 3 common

CC.name: Cocos Islands
CC.lines: Australian-style white markings, very few marked roads
CC.tell: two flat coral atolls, bright white sand, palms, mowed grass, counts as Australia

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.lines: white centre + white outer; long dashed yellow lines, yellow pedestrian crossings
CH.tell: low-cam huge car blur, plain white plates with no EU strip, tall blue 7-stripe pedestrian sign

CL.name: Chile
CL.lines: all white, or all yellow in parks and snow areas; the two are never mixed
CL.tell: white Gen 3 car with black section, yellow chevrons with black arrows, orange taxi plates

CN.name: China
CN.lines: yellow centre divides opposing traffic, white lane dividers and white outers
CN.tell: tripod coverage, motion blur, no car at all, blue plates with white text

CO.name: Colombia
CO.lines: yellow centre, often dashed + white outer
CO.tell: yellow plates, white cross-braced signposts, green Pr km markers, pastel yellow taxis

CR.name: Costa Rica
CR.tell: unblurred white pickup with front antenna, ALTO signs, red taxis, orange 3-dot bollards

CW.name: Curaçao
CW.lines: white centre + white outer, Dutch convention
CW.tell: black car with roof rack, square white plates, cacti, blue street signs on yellow posts

CX.name: Christmas Island
CX.lines: white centre + white outer, Australian conventions throughout
CX.tell: silver pickup Google car with truck bed visible, yellow plates, dense tropical forest

CY.name: Cyprus
CY.lines: UK-style white centre and outer; double yellow kerb lines for no-parking
CY.script: Greek alphabet plus English; Greek all-caps on direction signs
CY.tell: drives left, yellow UK-style rear plates, triangular slant-top bollards, smallcam with antenna

CZ.name: Czechia
CZ.lines: all white; solid outer lines with no centre line very common
CZ.script: Latin (Czech); Ř Ě Ů unique vs Slovak; street is ulice not ulica
CZ.tell: orange double front reflector bollards, extra-wide B guardrail, red street signs on walls

DE.name: Germany
DE.tell: Gen 4 only, black-white bollards every 50 m, yellow town signs, Einbahnstraße one-way signs

DK.name: Denmark
DK.lines: all white; double centre lines common, outer lines made of small white squares
DK.tell: white bollard with orange stripe, pipe-framed red/blue direction signs, streets end -vej

DO.name: Dominican Republic
DO.lines: yellow centre + white outer, on notably dark smooth asphalt
DO.tell: car with two black-striped metal bars, PARE on yellow posts, yellow-and-white plates

EC.name: Ecuador
EC.tell: shitcam, white pickup with no antenna, ladder poles, teal sign backs, red-striped bollards

EE.name: Estonia
EE.lines: all white; outer lines often short dashes
EE.script: Latin (Estonian); Ä Ö Ü and Õ; tänav/tee for street
EE.tell: round baton bollards, red chevrons with white arrows, Gen 3 green blur, km marker perpendicular

EG.name: Egypt
EG.script: Arabic, occasional signs in trekker coverage
EG.tell: seven Gen3 trekkers, Cairo and Alexandria monuments, sandstone, no car shadow

ES.name: Spain
ES.lines: all white; rural outer lines sometimes dashed, unlike Portugal and Italy
ES.script: Latin (Spanish); ñ, plus Catalan, Basque, Galician regionally
ES.tell: orange bollard reflector, two white dots behind; yellow guardrail reflectors; 8-stripe ped sign

FI.name: Finland
FI.lines: outer lines always solid white; centre white dashes or yellow, yellow being phased out
FI.script: Latin (Finnish, some Swedish); ä ö, long double-vowel words
FI.tell: yellow road signs with thin yellow edge stroke, orange snow poles banded at top, K-Market

FK.name: Falkland Islands
FK.lines: no marked roads, all coverage is off-road Gen 3 trekker
FK.tell: counted as UK, trekkers only on Carcass, West Point and New Island

FO.name: Faroe Islands
FO.lines: all white; many narrow rural roads unmarked
FO.script: Latin (Faroese); Ø and Ð, no Þ unlike Icelandic
FO.tell: yellow wooden stick bollards, black pickup or roof-rack car, treeless green fjord walls

FR.name: France
FR.lines: all white; long spaced outer dashes, unique offset double-block centre dashes
FR.tell: pointed white bollard with reflector band, blue plates on utility poles, yellow D-road numbers

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.lines: all white; long centre dashes with cat's eyes between, double yellow kerb lines
GB.script: Latin (English); bilingual Welsh in Wales, Gaelic in Scotland
GB.tell: white front plate yellow rear, GIVE WAY signs, wooden poles with rod steps and zapped-man sticker

GH.name: Ghana
GH.lines: all white, many paved roads unmarked
GH.tell: roof rack with black tape on front-right bar, flag-coloured paint, orange-yellow taxi fenders

GI.name: Gibraltar
GI.lines: all white, UK-style; double yellow kerb lines
GI.tell: Rock of Gibraltar limestone, Gen 3 long antenna with silver tip, UK plates but drives on right

GL.name: Greenland
GL.lines: all white where marked; most roads unmarked
GL.tell: Gen 3 trekker only, odd vehicles and boats, small colourful wooden houses, treeless fjords

GR.name: Greece
GR.lines: faded solid white double centre lines; yellow lines commoner than rest of southern Europe
GR.script: Greek alphabet; direction signs yellow Greek over white English
GR.tell: harp poletops on tall dark wooden poles, yellow warning signs, roadside miniature churches

GS.name: South Georgia & Sandwich Islands
GS.lines: no roads, coverage is Gen 3 trekkers only
GS.tell: counted as UK, trekker in abandoned Grytviken plus three fjord trekkers

GT.name: Guatemala
GT.lines: single yellow centre + white outer, lines noticeably thinner than Mexico
GT.tell: grey car with roof rack and visible mirrors, ALTO signs, pink or green painted poles

GU.name: Guam
GU.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention; very many road reflectors
GU.script: Latin, English and Chamorro; Japanese, Korean, Chinese signage
GU.tell: blurred car, front-right antenna plus roof rack sliver, thick concrete poles, green street signs

HK.name: Hong Kong
HK.lines: white centre + white or yellow outer, yellow outers mark no-stopping on small roads
HK.script: Traditional Chinese with English, bilingual signs
HK.tell: white front / yellow rear plates, double-decker buses, very tall apartment blocks

HR.name: Croatia
HR.script: Latin only (Croatian); Č Ć Đ Š Ž; IJE where Serbian has E
HR.tell: B-type square guardrails, white wedge bollard with black rectangle, HR stickers, autumn Gen 3

HU.name: Hungary
HU.lines: all white, but bicycle-lane markings are yellow
HU.script: Latin (Hungarian); Ő and Ű unique; utca/út for street
HU.tell: concrete holey poles, very tall sign posts bolted with 4 bolts, green km markers

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.lines: white or yellow centre, outer lines always white
ID.script: Latin (Indonesian), Dutch-influenced spelling: televisi vs Malay televisyen
ID.tell: black plates in three white sections, yellow angled waystones, red-and-white banner rows

IE.name: Ireland
IE.lines: white centre; yellow dashed outer lines, double yellow kerb lines
IE.script: Latin (English plus Irish in italics on signs)
IE.tell: yellow diamond warning signs, YIELD not GIVE WAY, white front and rear plates

IL.name: Israel & the West Bank
IL.script: Hebrew + Arabic, English third line on signs
IL.tell: yellow plates with blue strip, hand-symbol stop signs, black-white striped pole bottoms

IM.name: Isle of Man
IM.tell: Gen 2 only, white front and yellow rear plate with red strip, blue urban bollards, gorse

IN.name: India
IN.lines: mostly white centre + white outer, yellow centre on some highways, yellow outers rare
IN.script: Devanagari plus many regional scripts, English on most signage
IN.tell: shitcam brown tint and circular blur, black-white striped signposts, trident-top concrete poles

IO.name: British Indian Ocean Territory
IO.lines: no road markings, coverage is Gen 3 trekker only
IO.tell: trekker on atoll beaches, coconut palms, mangroves, walks offshore, counts as UK

IQ.name: Iraq
IQ.tell: Gen1.5 overexposed trekker in Baghdad museum, pointed blur, date-palm patio

IS.name: Iceland
IS.lines: all white, never yellow; outer lines solid or rarely dashed
IS.tell: yellow bollard with white reflector, yellow direction signs, treeless black volcanic soil

IT.name: Italy
IT.lines: all white; solid outer lines with no centre line very common
IT.script: Latin (Italian); double consonants, via on street signs
IT.tell: short front plate with blue strips both sides, triangular white bollard black top, black sign backs

JE.name: Jersey
JE.lines: all white; yellow give-way lines at junctions instead of dotted white
JE.script: Latin (English; French and Jèrriais place names)
JE.tell: Gen 2 only, white/yellow plates with red crest and J prefix, yellow phone boxes, red granite walls

JO.name: Jordan
JO.script: Arabic, little English on commercial signs
JO.tell: black car with no antenna or brake light, white plates with green taxi strip, white-red chevrons

JP.name: Japan
JP.lines: white centre + white outer, yellow centre means no overtaking, never yellow outers
JP.tell: low-cam black or white car, screw-ridge concrete poles, hexagonal prefecture shields

KE.name: Kenya
KE.lines: yellow centre + solid white outer (reversed vs southern Africa)
KE.tell: Gen4 snorkel truck, grey Toyota follow SUV, Safaricom shops, yellow rear plates

KG.name: Kyrgyzstan
KG.lines: all white, often faded or absent; wide-gap double centre on some main roads
KG.script: Cyrillic (Kyrgyz); Ө Ү Ң absent from Russian
KG.tell: silver car with four bars, all Gen 3 winter, red-and-white triangle km markers

KH.name: Cambodia
KH.lines: yellow centre solid or dashed, white outers rare
KH.tell: black chevrons with yellow arrows, reversed vs all SEA, striped white car, ladder poles

KR.name: South Korea
KR.lines: yellow centre + white outer, red block markings on road
KR.tell: black-yellow pole stripes stopping short of ground, house-shaped blue address plates

KZ.name: Kazakhstan
KZ.lines: white; yellow outer lines on many steppe highways; yellow-and-white zebra crossings
KZ.script: Cyrillic (Kazakh) plus Latin; Ә Ғ Қ Ң Ө Ұ Ү Һ І absent from Russian
KZ.tell: white pickup camera car, yellow-black chevrons, urban gas pipes, ornate town entry arcs

LA.name: Laos
LA.lines: white centre + white outer typical, yellow centres uncommon
LA.script: Lao, curvy with fewer straight lines than Thai
LA.tell: yellow private plates, silver car with two-bar roof rack, only five cities covered

LB.name: Lebanon
LB.script: Arabic with French and English common
LB.tell: only Middle East shitcam, otherwise Gen3 trekker, deep red taxi plates, yellow mesh poles

LI.name: Liechtenstein
LI.lines: white centre + white outer; long dashed yellow lines and yellow crossings as in Switzerland
LI.tell: black plate, white text, red-yellow crest; low-cam blur; LIEMOBIL green bus stop signs

LK.name: Sri Lanka
LK.lines: white centre + white outer, rural roads often outer lines only with no centre
LK.script: Sinhala rounded, Tamil straighter, English alongside
LK.tell: blue-white-red car front through blur, holey concrete poles, long white / short yellow plates

LS.name: Lesotho
LS.lines: white centre + yellow outer, triple white centre lines
LS.tell: white car no antenna, bare tabletop mountains, Basotho blankets, roaming livestock

LT.name: Lithuania
LT.lines: all white; outer lines sometimes short dashes
LT.script: Latin (Lithuanian); hooks Ą Ę Į Ų, Ė with one dot; gatvė/g for street
LT.tell: square concrete poles with diagonal brace, orange-front wedge bollards, km marker at 45°

LU.name: Luxembourg
LU.tell: long yellow plates, framed yellow direction signs, white signposts, 3-bolt German-style bollard

LV.name: Latvia
LV.script: Latin (Latvian); macrons Ā Ē Ī, hooks Ģ Ķ Ļ Ņ; iela for street
LV.tell: alternating left-right hook poletops, thin curved bollards, km marker parallel to road

MC.name: Monaco
MC.tell: short plates with no blue strip, Gen 2 only, dense luxury apartments, tunnels, parked mopeds

ME.name: Montenegro
ME.script: Latin and Cyrillic (Montenegrin); Č Ć Đ Š Ž, rare Ś Ź
ME.tell: red circle coat of arms on plate, both A- and B-type guardrails often rusted, smallcam

MG.name: Madagascar
MG.script: Latin, Malagasy long words plus French
MG.tell: Gen3 trekker with people walking alongside, boat trekkers, tropical to arid swing

MK.name: North Macedonia
MK.script: Cyrillic (Macedonian), Latin on road signs; Ѓ and Ќ unique; Љ Њ Џ
MK.tell: never an antenna on the Gen 3 car, yellow-filled warning signs, red block on white plate

ML.name: Mali
ML.lines: tripod trekkers only, no road markings
ML.tell: tripod trekkers at mud-brick mosques, motion blur, saturated colour, arid sand

MN.name: Mongolia
MN.lines: white where present; many rural roads unmarked
MN.script: Cyrillic (Mongolian); Ө Ү, double vowels аа ЭЭ; ЗОГС stop sign
MN.tell: pickup with snorkel, roof rack, tent and red mirrors; white bowling-pin bollards, 2 red bands

MO.name: Macau
MO.lines: white centre + white outer, yellow kerbside lines for no-stopping
MO.tell: washed-out Generation 2 only, black plates with white text, blue-bordered bilingual street signs

MP.name: Northern Mariana Islands
MP.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention; very many road reflectors
MP.script: Latin, English and Chamorro; East Asian signage
MP.tell: blurred car, antenna close to camera, wooden poles, blue street signs, flame trees

MQ.name: Martinique
MQ.lines: white centre + white outer, French convention
MQ.tell: counted as France, only three Gen 3 trekkers, memorise them rather than metas

MT.name: Malta
MT.lines: all white; double yellow kerb lines as in UK and Ireland
MT.script: Latin (English and Maltese); Ċ Ġ Ħ Ż
MT.tell: limestone rubble walls everywhere, triq on street signs, short EU plates, covered balconies

MX.name: Mexico
MX.lines: single solid yellow centre + white outer; broken or double yellow also common
MX.script: Latin, Spanish; Nahuatl names with x, tl, -tlan, -ec
MX.tell: octagonal concrete poles, ALTO signs, small white bollards on black base, OXXO and Pemex

MY.name: Malaysia
MY.lines: white centre + white outer, double white centre common, only SEA country to use it
MY.script: Latin (Malay), Chinese characters common, some Tamil
MY.tell: BERHENTI stop signs, hexagonal yellow highway shields, white-and-blue kilometre markers

NA.name: Namibia
NA.script: Latin, English signage, German and Afrikaans place names
NA.tell: white truck with short antenna leaning left, yellow front and rear plates, stone bollards

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.lines: often missing or faded, white when present
NG.tell: pickup with cab and bed visible, police follow car, greenish short plates, shitcam

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.lines: all white; dashed outer lines common, rare green centre lines
NL.tell: yellow plates front and rear, no street-level utility poles, red-pink bike lanes, dead flat

NO.name: Norway
NO.lines: orange-tinted yellow centre on larger roads; white outer, long dashes on smaller roads
NO.tell: yellow direction signs, white-background road signs, orange snow poles with mid reflector

NP.name: Nepal
NP.lines: yellow outer lines solid or dashed, dashed white centre on bigger roads
NP.script: Devanagari, native Devanagari numerals common on signs
NP.tell: all coverage shitcam, trident poletop with triangle supports, white stupas with painted eyes

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.lines: white outers, yellow dashed outers in towns, centre dashed white or double solid yellow
NZ.tell: bollard red strip wrapping the back, red-crest state highway shields, red-text GIVE WAY

OM.name: Oman
OM.tell: blurred white truck, yellow private and red commercial plates, be'ah bins, triangle pole tops

PA.name: Panama
PA.lines: yellow centre + white outer; solid white outer with no centre line near-unique
PA.tell: fully blurred white pickup, thick-font ALTO, turquoise-topped plates, yellow chequer taxis

PE.name: Peru
PE.lines: white outer always; dashed or double yellow centre, mountain roads have no centre
PE.tell: black-white zebra signposts on concrete blocks, black-outer striped guardrails, S/ prices

PH.name: Philippines
PH.lines: yellow or white centre, combined yellow+white centre common, white outers
PH.script: Latin (Filipino), English very common on signs
PH.tell: concrete roads, tricycle tuk-tuks everywhere, tall square yellow waystones

PK.name: Pakistan
PK.lines: few marked roads in coverage, white markings where present
PK.script: Urdu in Nastaliq, curvier than Arabic, English common
PK.tell: Gen 3 trekker only, Mughal gardens and stone walls, Punjab plates with green left strip

PL.name: Poland
PL.lines: all white; double centre lines very common and a strong Poland clue
PL.script: Latin (Polish); Ł Ń Ż unique, Ą Ę Ś Ź Ć; W not V, heavy consonant clusters
PL.tell: thin holey poles, yellow warning triangles with thin red border, one-line pedestrian sign

PM.name: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
PM.lines: white centre + white outer, French convention
PM.tell: counted as France, EU blue-strip plates, Gen 3 trekker only, colourful wooden houses

PN.name: Pitcairn Islands
PN.lines: no road markings, dirt tracks only
PN.tell: Gen 3 trekker on forested dirt tracks, semi-tropical, tiny island, counts as UK

PR.name: Puerto Rico
PR.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention
PR.tell: smallcam, PARE signs, (787) phone code, green km markers, no front plates, Walmart

PT.name: Portugal
PT.lines: all white; outer lines solid, dashed outer lines essentially absent
PT.script: Latin (Portuguese); Ç Ã Õ, no Ñ
PT.tell: yellow strip on right of plate, tall-step ladder poles, black chevrons with yellow arrows

PT-AZ.name: Azores
PT-AZ.tell: volcanic dry-stone walls, hydrangeas, Japanese cedars, tiled street signs, black-white cows

PT-MA.name: Madeira
PT-MA.tell: steep terraces and tunnels, agapanthus, white concrete block barriers, brown-white cows

QA.name: Qatar
QA.lines: solid white outer, centre white or yellow
QA.tell: white truck with antenna on the left, white plates with maroon strip, thobe crossing signs

RE.name: Reunion
RE.tell: roof rack with tape on rear-right bar, French bollards, volcanic peaks, counts as France

RO.name: Romania
RO.lines: all white; centre lines unusually thick, outer lines short dashes with narrow gaps
RO.script: Latin (Romanian); Ă Ș Ț plus Â Î
RO.tell: huge yellow pole stickers with town name, wide-hole holey poles, Dacia everywhere, waystones

RS.name: Serbia
RS.script: Cyrillic and Latin (Serbian); Ђ Ћ unique, Љ Њ Џ; Latin Č Ć Đ Š Ž
RS.tell: B-profile guardrails only, black-on-white chevrons, biscriptal yellow direction signs

RU.name: Russia
RU.lines: all white; outer lines often dashed; zebra crossings alternate white and yellow stripes
RU.script: Cyrillic (Russian); Ы Э Ё Ъ; улица/ул for street, город/г for city
RU.tell: fully white plate, no blue strip; bollard spam at very wide intersections; square concrete poles

RW.name: Rwanda
RW.lines: all white centre and outer, many roads unmarked
RW.script: Latin, English and Kinyarwanda, some French
RW.tell: hazy Gen4 blurred truck, ventilation bricks, red-vest motorcyclists, red soil

SE.name: Sweden
SE.lines: all white, never yellow; short dashed outer lines, segmented outer lines on highways
SE.tell: yellow road signs with red border, blue chevrons with yellow arrows, red-yellow striped signposts

SG.name: Singapore
SG.lines: white centre, double yellow outers on main roads, black-and-white kerbs
SG.script: Latin (English), Chinese, Tamil and Malay also official
SG.tell: green rounded street signs, all road signs on square white backing, lime-green buses

SI.name: Slovenia
SI.lines: all white; long dashed outer lines, unlike neighbours
SI.script: Latin (Slovene); Č Š Ž only, no Ć or Đ; ulica for street
SI.tell: yellow direction signs with black border, white bollard with black top, kozolec hay racks

SJ.name: Svalbard
SJ.lines: few marked roads; all white where present
SJ.tell: black plates with yellow text, barren treeless arctic mountains, overcast gloom

SK.name: Slovakia
SK.script: Latin (Slovak); Ľ Ô Ä Ŕ Ĺ unique vs Czech; ulica for street
SK.tell: orange double front reflector bollards, bold sign font, white street signs with red border

SM.name: San Marino
SM.tell: Monte Titano and its three towers, short white plates, yellow chevrons with burgundy arrows

SN.name: Senegal
SN.lines: white, French style, often absent on rural roads
SN.script: Latin, French, the only Francophone sub-Saharan coverage
SN.tell: fully blue plates, Gen3 car with right mirror visible, pink-outlined town signs, rifts

ST.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
ST.tell: dim hazy shitcam, slanted side antenna, CST on blue-based poles, Portuguese ladder poles

SZ.name: Eswatini
SZ.lines: white centre + yellow outer, occasional triple white centre
SZ.tell: MR road numbers, tall golden grass, green-bottom plates, white car no antenna

TH.name: Thailand
TH.lines: yellow centre solid or dashed + white outers
TH.script: Thai, compact with tiny circles inside letters
TH.tell: square pinhole concrete poles, Garuda road markers, bulky white black-footed signposts

TN.name: Tunisia
TN.lines: all white, outer dashed or solid; rare yellow centre in Sfax
TN.tell: black plates, follow car escorting black Google car, raked olive plantations

TR.name: Turkey
TR.lines: white on most roads, but fully yellow or mixed yellow-and-white is not uncommon
TR.script: Latin (Turkish); dotless ı and dotted İ, plus Ç Ş Ğ Ö Ü
TR.tell: DUR stop signs, ladder or mesh metal utility poles, minarets, salt-and-pepper asphalt

TW.name: Taiwan
TW.lines: double yellow centre + white outer, red outers mean no parking, white outers with no centre common
TW.tell: black-yellow pole stripes running to the ground, orange-hooded mirrors, green transformer boxes

TZ.name: Tanzania
TZ.lines: trekkers only; Kenya-border spills use yellow centre + white outer
TZ.tell: Gombe and Kilimanjaro trekkers and tripods, off-road, plus Kenya-border car spills

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.lines: all white; frequently worn away on very poor, potholed rural pavement
UA.script: Cyrillic (Ukrainian); Є Ґ І Ї; вулиця/вул for street, місто/м for city
UA.tell: blue-and-yellow strip on plate, red Gen 3 car, all coverage Gen 3, worst roads in Europe

UG.name: Uganda
UG.tell: Kampala and Entebbe plus national parks only, white front and yellow rear plates, red-tinged roads

UM-MQ.name: US Minor Outlying Islands
UM-MQ.lines: no marked public roads, much of Midway coverage runs along two runways
UM-MQ.tell: counted as US, Gen 2 on Midway, albatrosses in nearly every shot, trekkers elsewhere

US.name: United States of America
US.lines: yellow centre, most often double + white outer; median-side outer line is yellow
US.script: Latin, English with American spelling, miles
US.tell: SPEED LIMIT signs, No Passing Zone triangles, orange white-striped barrels, wooden poles

US-AK.name: Alaska
US-AK.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention
US-AK.tell: all-yellow plates, Big Dipper highway shield, shitcam and Gen 2 common, snowy peaks

US-HI.name: Hawaii
US-HI.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention; reflectors in a 1-4-1 pattern
US-HI.script: Latin, English and Hawaiian: vowel-heavy names, okina
US-HI.tell: guitar-pick highway shields on yellow posts, yellow pole bands, volcanic rock walls

UY.name: Uruguay
UY.lines: unique double yellow with white dashes between; also yellow-white, or all white
UY.tell: black Gen 3 car, smudgy camera, trident poles, white wooden signposts, green km stones

VI.name: US Virgin Islands
VI.lines: yellow centre + white outer, US convention
VI.script: Latin, English; Danish street names ending in gade
VI.tell: drives left despite US territory, big red or white Google car, short blue plates
